verdict.rationale: Dagster's docs include an OSS deployment section describing a self-hosted Docker setup with separate webserver, daemon and code-location containers. The core is published on GitHub and installable locally via uvx/create-dagster. Community comments about running tasks in Kubernetes pods and seamless laptop-to-prod development add light corroboration. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement, evidence of other documented self-host targets such as Kubernetes/Helm, and independent hands-on reports of running a self-hosted production deployment.
